description: Get the full profile for a politician including party, state, chamber, trade statistics, filing delay metrics, most traded sector, and their 10 most recent transactions. The politician is identified by URL slug (e.g. "sen-nancy-pelosi").

slug.description: Politician URL slug (e.g., "sen-nancy-pelosi", "sen-tommy-tuberville") Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only, exactly as returned by get_politicians (a name with spaces or capitals is rejected).

name: get_politician_detail
title: Get Politician Detail
